title: Manual Journal Entry Documentation
content: Before submission, every manual journal entry must include a business purpose, supporting evidence, preparer identity, company code, amount, currency and posting date.

title: High-Value Journal Entry Approval
content: Journal entries above USD 10,000 require approval from both the Finance Manager and Controller before posting. The preparer cannot approve their own journal entry.

title: Period-Close Exception Posting
content: A journal entry submitted after the period-close cutoff requires a documented business justification and Controller exception approval before it can be posted.

title: Vendor Bank Account Changes
content: Vendor bank account changes require independent verification of the request, supporting documentation and approval from an AP Manager before the master-data change is released.

title: Payroll Adjustment Records
content: Payroll adjustment records contain restricted employee compensation data and may only be reviewed by Payroll, Controller or authorized Audit personnel.

title: Read-Only Audit Evidence
content: Authorized auditors may receive read-only access to approved journal evidence. Audit access does not permit posting, changing or approving financial transactions.
